# @hakistudio/hakiui — reference for AI coding agents

> Read this whole file before writing any code that uses HakiUI. Every prop
> listed here is the complete public API — if a prop is not listed, it does
> not exist. Do not guess props from other libraries (shadcn, MUI, Chakra).

HakiUI is a themable React + Tailwind v4 component library. Brand: pixel
orange `#F05423` on warm paper-white (light) or warm charcoal (dark), IBM Plex
Mono, 4px radius. Live demos: https://hakiui.akhsanhakiki.com/components

## 1. Setup

### 1a. Install
```bash
npm install @hakistudio/hakiui
```
Start with an existing React 18/19 app. HakiUI installs `lucide-react` itself.
Tailwind v4 is required (`tailwindcss` + `@tailwindcss/vite` for Vite, or
`@tailwindcss/postcss` for Next.js). Tailwind v3 does not work.

### 1b. Global stylesheet — both lines, in this order
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@hakistudio/hakiui/styles.css";
```
`styles.css` contains an `@source` directive that makes your Tailwind build
scan the package's compiled components. Without it your build generates none
of the utility classes the components use, and you will see exactly these
symptoms: inputs show the browser's default black/blue focus outline, buttons
have no height or padding, focus rings are missing. If you see those, the
stylesheet import is missing or `@import "tailwindcss"` is absent.

No-Tailwind alternative (prebuilt, cannot be purged):
`@import "@hakistudio/hakiui/hakiui.css";` instead of both lines above.

### 1c. Load the font
The default theme uses IBM Plex Mono but the package does not load it. Add
to `index.html` `<head>` (or Next.js layout):
```html
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
```
Or pass a font you already load: `initialTheme={{ ...defaultTheme, fontFamily: "'Inter', sans-serif" }}`.

### 1d. Use components directly and paint the page background
```tsx
import { Button } from "@hakistudio/hakiui";

export default function App() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen" style={{ background: "var(--bg)" }}>
      <Button variant="primary">Continue</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```
The stylesheet sets the default tokens on `:root`; no provider is required.
Paint the root with `var(--bg)` if you want the full page to use the warm paper
background (#FAF9F5).

For runtime theme switching, `HakiProvider` and `useTheme` remain available.
In Next.js App Router, put that optional provider in a `"use client"` component.

## 2. Theme tokens

The stylesheet sets these CSS custom properties on `:root`; the optional
`HakiProvider` can override them on its wrapper. Use them —
never hard-code hex colours or Tailwind palette colours (`bg-orange-500`,
`text-gray-500`, `border-gray-300`) in app code that sits next to HakiUI
components, or the app will not retheme and will not match the components.

| Variable | Meaning | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ui-primary` | brand colour | `#F05423` | same |
| `--ui-primary-rgb` | `240 84 35` for `rgb(var(--ui-primary-rgb) / 0.12)` | | |
| `--ui-primary-bg` | primary fill (solid or gradient) | | |
| `--ui-font` | font stack | `'IBM Plex Mono', monospace` | |
| `--ui-radius` | base radius | `4px` | |
| `--bg` | page background | `#FAF9F5` | `#141311` |
| `--bg-soft` | subtle fill (input bg, code blocks) | `#F2EFE8` | `#1C1A17` |
| `--surface` | cards, modals, popovers | `#FFFFFF` | `#22201B` |
| `--border` | hairline borders | `#E5E1D5` | `#37342C` |
| `--input` | alt input fill | `#F2EFE8` | `#282521` |
| `--text` | primary text | `#1C1B17` | `#F5F3EC` |
| `--text-muted` | secondary text | `#6E6A5E` | `#A8A294` |
| `--hover` | hover fill for rows/ghost buttons | `#EBE7DC` | `#322E27` |
| `--ui-success` / `--ui-warning` / `--ui-danger` | status colours used by Alert, Badge, Progress, Toast, ToolCalls | `#0CA30C` / `#B87A00` / `#D03B3B` | same |
| `--chart-1`…`--chart-8` | categorical chart palette | | |

In Tailwind v4 use them as `bg-(--surface)`, `text-(--text-muted)`,
`border-(--border)`, `text-(--ui-primary)`. In inline styles use
`var(--surface)`. For a card:
`<div className="bg-(--surface) border border-(--border) rounded-[var(--ui-radius)] p-4">`.

### Theme type
```ts
type Theme = {
  primaryColor: string;   // hex
  gradientColor: string;  // hex, used only when useGradient
  useGradient: boolean;
  fontFamily: string;     // CSS font-family value
  borderRadius: number;   // px
  mode?: "light" | "dark";
  successColor?: string;  // optional status overrides
  warningColor?: string;
  dangerColor?: string;
};
```
`defaultTheme` = `{ primaryColor: "#F05423", gradientColor: "#FF8C42",
useGradient: false, fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", borderRadius: 4,
mode: "light" }`.

### Runtime theming
```tsx
const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme(); // must be inside HakiProvider
setTheme({ ...theme, mode: theme.mode === "dark" ? "light" : "dark" });
setTheme({ ...theme, primaryColor: "#2A78D6", borderRadius: 8 });
```

### Radius prop (shared by most components)
`type Radius = "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "full"` — relative to
`--ui-radius` (`sm` = ×0.5, `md` = ×1, `lg` = ×1.5, `full` = 9999px).
Default is `"md"` unless stated.

## 3. Imports

Barrel: `import { Button, Input, … } from "@hakistudio/hakiui"`.
Per-component (smaller bundles): `import { Button } from "@hakistudio/hakiui/button"`.
Subpaths: `theme-provider`, `button`, `input`, `pagination`, `switch`,
`tooltip`, `table`, `tabs`, `accordion`, `checkbox`, `radio`, `calendar`,
`modal`, `drawer`, `dropdown`, `autocomplete`, `bar-chart`, `line-chart`,
`date-picker`, `toast`, `alert`, `badge`, `avatar`, `progress`, `skeleton`,
`spinner`, `slider`, `stepper`, `breadcrumbs`, `chip`, `kbd`, `menu`, `otp-input`,
`sidebar`, `model-selector`, `prompt-input`, `chat-message`, `thinking-steps`,
`tool-calls`, `prompt-suggestions`, `radius`, `hex-to-rgb`, `tokens`.

Icons: the library uses `lucide-react`; use it for icons in app code too.

## 4. Components — complete API

Conventions: every `size` is `"sm" | "md" | "lg"` unless stated; default
`"md"`. `className` on components that extend native elements lands on the
INNER native element, not the wrapper — do not use it to add borders,
backgrounds or focus rings; the component already draws those.

### Button
```ts
interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost"; // default "primary"
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  radius?: Radius;
}
```
- `primary` solid brand fill, white text. `secondary` 12% brand tint, brand
  text. `outline` hairline border, text colour. `ghost` no border, hover fill.
- Heights: sm 32px, md 36px, lg 40px. Has press-bounce animation built in.
- There is NO `destructive`, `link`, `icon`, `default` variant and NO
  `asChild`, `isLoading`, `leftIcon` prop. For an icon button:
  `<Button variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="Close"><X size={16} /></Button>`.
- Loading: `<Button disabled><Spinner size="sm" color="current" /> Saving…</Button>`.
- Destructive action: keep `variant="primary"` or `outline`; do not invent red.
```tsx
<Button variant="primary">Continue</Button>
<Button variant="outline" size="sm">Cancel</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" onClick={…}><Plus size={16} /> Add</Button>
```

### Input
```ts
interface InputProps extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "size"> {
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  label?: string;
  labelPlacement?: "top" | "left";   // default "top"
  description?: ReactNode;           // helper text under the field
  startContent?: ReactNode;          // e.g. <Mail size={15} />
  endContent?: ReactNode;
  radius?: Radius;
}
```
- Renders its own container (soft bg, hairline border, brand focus ring) and
  its own `<label>`. Do NOT wrap it in another bordered div and do NOT add a
  separate `<label>`; use the `label` prop.
- `type="password"` automatically gets a show/hide eye toggle.
- `className` goes on the inner `<input>`. Never pass `border-*`, `ring-*`,
  `outline-*`, `bg-*`, `rounded-*`, `px-*`, `py-*` through it.
- No `error` / `isInvalid` prop. Show errors with `description` and a
  `text-(--ui-primary)` or `Alert variant="danger"`.
```tsx
<Input label="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@company.com" startContent={<Mail size={15} />} />
<Input label="Password" type="password" description="At least 8 characters" />
<Input size="sm" labelPlacement="left" label="Search" endContent={<Search size={14} />} />
```
There is no `Textarea` component. For multi-line text use a plain
`<textarea>` styled with tokens:
`className="w-full bg-(--bg-soft) text-(--text) border border-(--border) rounded-[var(--ui-radius)] px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-(--ui-primary) placeholder:text-(--text-muted)"`.

### Checkbox
```ts
{ checked: boolean; onChange: (checked: boolean) => void; children?: ReactNode; radius?: Radius /* default "sm" */ }
```
Controlled only. Label is `children`. No `onCheckedChange`, `label`,
`indeterminate`, `disabled`.
```tsx
<Checkbox checked={agree} onChange={setAgree}>I agree to the terms</Checkbox>
```

### Radio
```ts
{ checked: boolean; onChange: () => void; children?: ReactNode }
```
No group component — render one `Radio` per option:
```tsx
{["Monthly","Yearly"].map(p => <Radio key={p} checked={plan===p} onChange={() => setPlan(p)}>{p}</Radio>)}
```

### Switch
```ts
{ checked: boolean; onChange: (checked: boolean) => void; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" }
```
No label prop; put text beside it in a flex row.

### Dropdown (select)
```ts
interface DropdownOption { label: string; value: string; description?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }
interface DropdownProps {
  options: DropdownOption[];
  value?: string; defaultValue?: string; onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string; label?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; radius?: Radius; disabled?: boolean; className?: string;
}
```
Single-select, string values only. No `multiple`, no `<option>` children.
```tsx
<Dropdown label="Role" placeholder="Choose…" options={[{label:"Admin",value:"admin"},{label:"Viewer",value:"viewer"}]} value={role} onChange={setRole} />
```

### Autocomplete (combobox)
```ts
interface AutocompleteOption { label: string; value: string; description?: ReactNode }
interface AutocompleteProps {
  options: AutocompleteOption[];
  value?: string; defaultValue?: string;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;        // selected value
  onInputChange?: (text: string) => void;    // typed text
  placeholder?: string; emptyMessage?: string; label?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; radius?: Radius; disabled?: boolean; className?: string;
}
```

### DatePicker
```ts
interface DatePickerProps {
  value?: Date | null; defaultValue?: Date | null; onChange?: (date: Date | null) => void;
  label?: string; placeholder?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; radius?: Radius; disabled?: boolean;
  clearable?: boolean; minDate?: Date; maxDate?: Date;
  formatValue?: (date: Date) => string; className?: string;
}
```
Single date only; no range.

### Calendar
```ts
{ radius?: Radius }
```
Uncontrolled month view with internal selection — demo/decorative only. For
a form field use `DatePicker`.

### Slider
```ts
interface SliderProps {
  value?: number; defaultValue?: number; onChange?: (value: number) => void;
  min?: number; max?: number; step?: number;
  label?: string; showValue?: boolean; formatValue?: (v: number) => string;
  size?: "sm" | "md"; disabled?: boolean; className?: string;
}
```
Single thumb only.

### Stepper (numeric +/- input)
```ts
interface StepperProps {
  value?: number; defaultValue?: number; onChange?: (value: number) => void;
  min?: number; max?: number; step?: number;
  label?: string; labelPlacement?: "top" | "left";
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; radius?: Radius; disabled?: boolean;
  formatValue?: (v: number) => string; className?: string; "aria-label"?: string;
}
```
This is a quantity stepper, NOT a multi-step wizard progress indicator.
Build a wizard indicator from `Badge` / `Progress` if you need one.

### Tabs
```ts
{ items: { id: string; label: string; content: ReactNode }[] }
```
Uncontrolled; first item active. No `value`/`onChange`, no `TabsList`/
`TabsTrigger`/`TabsContent` sub-components.
```tsx
<Tabs variant="segmented" items={[{ id: "overview", label: "Overview", content: <Overview /> }, { id: "settings", label: "Settings", content: <Settings /> }]} />
```

`variant`: `"underline"` (default) or `"segmented"`.
`size`: `"sm"`, `"md"` (default), or `"lg"`.

### Accordion / AccordionItem
```ts
Accordion: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }
AccordionItem: { title: string; children: ReactNode }
```
Each item toggles independently; no `type="single"`, no `defaultValue`.

### Table
```ts
Table: { children: ReactNode; radius?: Radius; variant?: "default" | "rounded" }
TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableColumn (th), TableCell (td): { children: ReactNode }
```
```tsx
<Table>
  <TableHeader><TableColumn>Name</TableColumn><TableColumn>Status</TableColumn></TableHeader>
  <TableBody>
    {rows.map(r => <TableRow key={r.id}><TableCell>{r.name}</TableCell><TableCell><Badge color="success" variant="soft">{r.status}</Badge></TableCell></TableRow>)}
  </TableBody>
</Table>
```
`TableHeader` already renders the `<tr>` — put `TableColumn`s directly inside
it. No sorting/selection props.

### Pagination
```ts
{ total: number /* page count */; page: number /* 1-based */; onChange: (page: number) => void }
```

### Breadcrumbs
```ts
type BreadcrumbItem = { label: ReactNode; href?: string; onClick?: () => void };
interface BreadcrumbsProps { items: BreadcrumbItem[]; separator?: ReactNode; className?: string }
```
Last item renders as the current page.

### Modal
```ts
interface ModalProps { isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; title: string; children: ReactNode }
```
`title` is required. No `size`, `footer`, or `Dialog.*` sub-components — put
action buttons at the bottom of `children`:
```tsx
<Modal isOpen={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Delete project">
  <p className="text-sm text-(--text-muted)">This cannot be undone.</p>
  <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-2">
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button onClick={confirm}>Delete</Button>
  </div>
</Modal>
```

### Drawer
```ts
interface DrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void;
  side?: "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom";  // default "left"
  size?: string;                                // CSS length, default "320px"
  title?: ReactNode; children: ReactNode;
  closeOnOverlayClick?: boolean; showCloseButton?: boolean; className?: string;
}
```

### Tooltip
```ts
{ content: ReactNode; position?: "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right"; children: ReactNode }
```
Hover-only, wraps its child in an inline-flex container.

### Toast — `ToastProvider` + `useToast`
```ts
type ToastProviderProps = { children: ReactNode; position?: "top-right" | "top-left" | "bottom-right" | "bottom-left"; radius?: Radius };
type ToastOptions = { title: string; description?: ReactNode; variant?: "default" | "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info"; duration?: number /* ms; 0 = sticky */ };
```
```tsx
<ToastProvider position="bottom-right"><App /></ToastProvider>
// in a component:
const { toast, dismiss } = useToast();
const id = toast({ title: "Saved", variant: "success" }); // returns id
// dismiss(id) to close early
```
`ToastProvider` works without `HakiProvider`; it reads the stylesheet's theme tokens.

### Alert
```ts
interface AlertProps { variant?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger"; title?: string; children?: ReactNode; radius?: Radius; onClose?: () => void; className?: string }
```
`onClose` present ⇒ close button shown.

### Badge
```ts
interface BadgeProps { children: ReactNode; color?: "primary" | "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger"; variant?: "solid" | "soft" | "outline"; size?: "sm" | "md"; radius?: Radius; className?: string }
```
Use `variant="soft"` for status pills in tables.

### Avatar / AvatarGroup
```ts
interface AvatarProps { src?: string; alt?: string; name?: string /* initials fallback */; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl"; radius?: Radius; className?: string }
interface AvatarGroupProps { children: ReactNode; max?: number; size?: AvatarSize; radius?: Radius; className?: string }
```

### Progress
```ts
interface ProgressProps { value?: number /* 0–100 */; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; color?: "primary" | "success" | "warning" | "danger"; label?: string; showValue?: boolean; indeterminate?: boolean; radius?: Radius; className?: string }
```

### Skeleton
```ts
interface SkeletonProps { variant?: "rect" | "text" | "circle"; width?: number | string; height?: number | string; radius?: Radius; className?: string }
```

### Spinner
```ts
interface SpinnerProps { size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; color?: "primary" | "current"; label?: string; className?: string }
```

### BarChart / LineChart
```ts
type ChartSeries = { key: string; label?: string; color?: string };
interface BarChartProps {
  data: Record<string, string | number>[]; xKey: string; series: ChartSeries[];
  stacked?: boolean; height?: number; showValues?: boolean;
  valueFormatter?: (v: number) => string; className?: string; "aria-label"?: string;
}
interface LineChartProps {
  data: Record<string, string | number>[]; xKey: string; series: ChartSeries[];
  area?: boolean; curve?: "smooth" | "linear"; height?: number; showDots?: boolean;
  valueFormatter?: (v: number) => string; className?: string; "aria-label"?: string;
}
```
Series colours come from `--chart-1…8` in order; don't pass `color` unless a
one-off is required. Charts fill their container width — give the parent a
width.
```tsx
<BarChart data={[{ month: "Jan", revenue: 12, cost: 8 }, …]} xKey="month" series={[{ key: "revenue", label: "Revenue" }, { key: "cost", label: "Cost" }]} height={240} />
```

### Chip
```ts
interface ChipProps { children; onClick?: () => void; onRemove?: () => void; selected?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; size?: "sm" | "md"; color?: "primary" | "neutral"; icon?: ReactNode; radius?: Radius /* "full" */; className?: string }
```
An interactive tag (filter, suggestion, selected option). Renders a `<button>` when `onClick` is given; `onRemove` adds an × control. Use Badge for read-only labels.

### Kbd
```ts
interface KbdProps { keys?: string[]; children?: ReactNode; size?: "sm" | "md" }
```
`<Kbd keys={["⌘", "K"]} />` — one cap per key.

### Menu
```ts
type MenuItem =
  | { label: string; description?: string; icon?: ReactNode; shortcut?: string[]; danger?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onSelect: () => void }
  | { heading: string }
  | { separator: true };
interface MenuProps { items: MenuItem[]; trigger: (props) => ReactNode; placement?: "bottom-start" | "bottom-end" | "top-start" | "top-end"; radius?: Radius }
```
Action menu with arrow keys / Enter / Escape and outside-click close. Spread the `props` the trigger receives onto a button:
```tsx
<Menu
  trigger={(p) => <Button {...p} variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="More"><MoreHorizontal size={14} /></Button>}
  items={[
    { heading: "Actions" },
    { label: "Rename", icon: <Pencil size={13} />, shortcut: ["⌘", "E"], onSelect: rename },
    { separator: true },
    { label: "Delete", icon: <Trash2 size={13} />, danger: true, onSelect: remove },
  ]}
/>
```

### OtpInput
```ts
interface OtpInputProps { length?: number /* 6 */; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; onComplete?: (v: string) => void; groups?: number[] /* gap after these indexes, e.g. [3] */; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"; radius?: Radius; disabled?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean; mode?: "numeric" | "alphanumeric"; label?: string }
```
Paste fills every cell; Backspace walks back; arrows move.

### Sidebar / SidebarSection / SidebarItem
```ts
interface SidebarProps { children; header?: ReactNode; footer?: ReactNode; collapsed?: boolean; onCollapsedChange?: (c: boolean) => void; width?: number /* 264 */; "aria-label"?: string }
interface SidebarSectionProps { title?: string; action?: ReactNode; children }
interface SidebarItemProps { children: ReactNode /* label */; icon?: ReactNode; active?: boolean; meta?: ReactNode; actions?: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; href?: string; radius?: Radius }
```
The AI app-shell column: brand/new-chat in `header`, grouped history (Pinned / Today / Yesterday…) as sections, account in `footer`. Passing `onCollapsedChange` shows the collapse toggle; collapsed = 56px icon rail. Put a `Menu` in `actions` for rename / pin / delete.
```tsx
<Sidebar header={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full"><Plus size={14} /> New chat</Button>} footer={<Avatar name="Kai Ito" size="sm" />} collapsed={collapsed} onCollapsedChange={setCollapsed}>
  <SidebarSection title="Pinned">
    <SidebarItem icon={<Pin size={14} />} active meta="Today">Q3 revenue summary</SidebarItem>
  </SidebarSection>
</Sidebar>
```

### ModelSelector
```ts
interface ModelOption { value: string; label: string; description?: string; badge?: string; disabled?: boolean }
interface ModelSelectorProps { options: ModelOption[]; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; placement?: "top" | "bottom" /* "top" */; icon?: ReactNode; size?: "sm" | "md"; radius?: Radius; disabled?: boolean }
```
Chip-sized picker for a composer toolbar; the list opens upward by default so it fits above a bottom-anchored PromptInput.

### PromptInput
```ts
interface PromptInputProps { value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; onSubmit: (v: string) => void; streaming?: boolean; onStop?: () => void; placeholder?: string; maxRows?: number /* 8 */; disabled?: boolean; leading?: ReactNode; trailing?: ReactNode; hint?: ReactNode; autoFocus?: boolean; radius?: Radius /* "lg" */ }
```
The chat composer. Enter sends (Shift+Enter = newline); while `streaming` the send button becomes Stop (`onStop`). Put `ModelSelector` and attach buttons in `leading`.
```tsx
<PromptInput value={draft} onChange={setDraft} onSubmit={send} streaming={busy} onStop={stop}
  leading={<ModelSelector options={models} value={model} onChange={setModel} />}
  hint="Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line" />
```

### ChatMessage
```ts
interface ChatMessageProps { role: "user" | "assistant"; children: ReactNode; avatar?: ReactNode; name?: string; time?: string; actions?: ReactNode; streaming?: boolean; radius?: Radius }
```
User turns: right-aligned tinted bubble. Assistant turns: full width under a sender line; `streaming` appends a blinking caret. Rich content (Markdown, tables, charts) goes in `children`.

### ThinkingSteps
```ts
interface ThinkingStepsProps { steps: string[]; streaming?: boolean; defaultOpen?: boolean; label?: string }
```
Collapsible reasoning trail; shimmering "Thinking…" while streaming.

### ToolCalls
```ts
interface ToolCall { name: string; status: "running" | "done" | "error"; detail?: string; duration?: string }
interface ToolCallsProps { calls: ToolCall[]; defaultOpen?: boolean; label?: string }
```
Badge row with live status (running spins, error in `--ui-danger`) plus a fold-out trail.

### PromptSuggestions
```ts
interface PromptSuggestion { title: string; prompt: string; category?: string; icon?: ReactNode }
interface PromptSuggestionsProps { items: PromptSuggestion[]; onPick: (prompt: string) => void; columns?: 1 | 2 | 3; radius?: Radius }
```
Empty-state starter cards; `onPick` hands the prompt to the composer.

### An AI chat screen, assembled
```tsx
<div className="flex h-screen bg-(--bg)">
  <Sidebar header={…} footer={…}>…</Sidebar>
  <main className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto p-6">
      {messages.length === 0 && <PromptSuggestions items={starters} onPick={setDraft} />}
      {messages.map((m) => (
        <ChatMessage key={m.id} role={m.role} name={m.role === "user" ? "You" : "Assistant"} time={m.time} streaming={m.streaming}>
          {m.role === "assistant" && m.steps && <ThinkingSteps steps={m.steps} streaming={m.streaming} />}
          {m.role === "assistant" && m.tools && <ToolCalls calls={m.tools} />}
          <p>{m.text}</p>
        </ChatMessage>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl p-4"><PromptInput … /></div>
  </main>
</div>
```

## 5. Building screens that match the design system

- Page: `bg-(--bg)`. Cards/panels: `bg-(--surface) border border-(--border)`
  with `rounded-[var(--ui-radius)]`. Sidebars/toolbars: `bg-(--bg-soft)`.
- Headings: `text-(--text) font-semibold`. Supporting text: `text-(--text-muted) text-sm`.
- Spacing: 16/24px rhythm (`p-4`, `p-6`, `gap-4`). Density like a real app,
  not a marketing page.
- Focus: components already draw a brand focus ring. Don't add
  `focus:ring-*` / `focus:outline-*` around them.
- Never restyle a component's internals via `className`. If you need a
  different look, change the theme (`setTheme`) or the token variables on a
  wrapper element.
- Dark mode = `mode: "dark"` in the theme (or `setTheme`), not Tailwind
  `dark:` classes — the tokens flip automatically.
- Components that do not exist here (Textarea, Select-multiple, Popover,
  Command palette, Sheet, Card, Separator, Form): build them from plain
  elements + tokens as shown for Textarea above. Do not import them from
  another UI library into the same screen. For chat UIs use PromptInput,
  ChatMessage, Sidebar, ModelSelector, ThinkingSteps, ToolCalls,
  PromptSuggestions — do not hand-roll a composer.

## 6. Checklist before you say "done"

1. `@import "tailwindcss"` then `@import "@hakistudio/hakiui/styles.css"` in the global CSS.
2. Components render without a provider; paint the root with `var(--bg)` if you want the page background.
3. IBM Plex Mono (or the chosen `fontFamily`) is actually loaded.
4. No raw `<button>`/`<input>` where `Button`/`Input` exist; no
   `border-gray-*`, `bg-orange-*`, `focus:ring-black` etc. in app code.
5. Focus an input: the ring is translucent orange, not black/blue. If it's
   black/blue, step 1 is wrong.
